findings.evidence: grep hits: `FundamentalGroupProduct.lean:88 ... [SimplyConnectedSpace Y]`, `:109 ... [SimplyConnectedSpace X]`; the bodies immediately do `haveI : Unique (FundamentalGroup Y y) := uniqueOfSubsingleton 1` / `FundamentalGroup X x`, and TauCeti already uses the weaker convention in `TauCeti/AlgebraicTopology/FundamentalGroup.lean:36` with `[Subsingleton (_root_.FundamentalGroup A a₀)]` before giving simply-connected corollaries.
findings.fix: State the projection equivalences with the pointwise assumption, e.g. `(x : X) (y : Y) [Subsingleton (FundamentalGroup Y y)] : FundamentalGroup (X × Y) (x,y) ≃* FundamentalGroup X x`, and derive simply-connected wrappers if desired; update the cylinder lemmas to use the same weaker hypothesis where they only project away `Y`.
findings.issue: `prodMulEquivFst`/`prodMulEquivSnd` and their simp lemmas are under-generalized: they assume `[SimplyConnectedSpace Y]` or `[SimplyConnectedSpace X]` although the construction only uses triviality of `FundamentalGroup Y y` or `FundamentalGroup X x`.

summary: The projection and cylinder APIs require simply connected complementary factors where the proofs only need the based fundamental group to be trivial.
